purpose: Teach: 存分/思いつか/おそらくは/久し振り/こんばんわ/すっごい/言い聞かせ/戸惑い

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、休みは存分に遊んだろ?
lines.en: Riku, you had plenty of time to mess around over break, didn't you?
lines.style: Light, teasing opening. Casual confidence—the tone of someone who knows what her friend's been up to. Quick pace, slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、宿題のテーマ思いつかないんだろ?桜
lines.en: You're stuck on the homework theme, aren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Easy counter-question, almost conspiratorial. Not accusatory—just turning the mirror back. Dry, observant tone. Slight lift at the end like he's genuinely curious about her dodge.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、おそらくは志望校受かるよ
lines.en: You're going to get into your target school, Riku. Probably.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact conviction underneath casual delivery. Said like it's obvious but she's testing the waters—almost doesn't want him to hear how much she means it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、久し振りに塾来たな、桜
lines.en: So you actually came back to cram school. It's been a while, Sakura.
lines.style: Observation delivered quietly, without judgment. Slight surprise underneath—the kind of thing he noticed the moment she walked in. Warm but not pushing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、先生に「こんばんわ」って挨拶しろよ
lines.en: Go on—greet the teacher with a proper 'good evening,' Riku.
lines.style: Brief, direct instruction with affectionate undertone. She's nudging him toward something small but real. Quick and clear, like she's said this kind of thing before.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のテスト、すっごい点数だったぞ、桜
lines.en: That test score of yours was incredible, Sakura.
lines.style: Straightforward admiration. No buildup, just honest weight on the words. He's not one to inflate praise, so when he says it, it lands.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、自分に「集中」と言い聞かせて勉強しろよ
lines.en: Tell yourself to focus, Riku. That's how you study.
lines.style: Coaching tone, but not bossy. She's offering him something she figured out herself. Steady, encouraging pace. A little firmer on 'focus'—the word that matters.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、初日は戸惑いがあったろ?桜
lines.en: The first day was rough for you, wasn't it, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet, tentative. He's remembering something specific—the hesitation in his voice is deliberate. Gentle enough that she knows he's not trying to wound, but close enough that it matters.
